name: Coro and its Port
description: Coro is a colonial town in Venezuela's northwestern Falcón state, founded in 1527, with its port, La Vela de Coro, on the Caribbean coast. Its streets are lined with some 602 historic buildings made of earth, blending local building traditions with Spanish Mudéjar and Dutch styles in a way found nowhere else in the Caribbean. It was Venezuela's first World Heritage Site and is now listed as in danger.
